description: This file implements a Redis Cluster cache class, RedisClusterCache, which extends RedisCache. It manages Redis Cluster clients, overrides methods for multi-get operations, and includes a method to test the Redis Cluster connection.

classes.name: RedisClusterCache
classes.description: A cache class that manages Redis Cluster connections, overrides multi-get methods, and provides a connection testing method.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the RedisClusterCache instance, setting up Redis cluster client attributes.

methods.name: init_async_client
methods.description: Initializes and returns the asynchronous RedisCluster client, reusing existing client if available.

methods.name: _run_redis_mget_operation
methods.description: Overrides the base method to perform a non-atomic multi-get operation using the Redis client.

methods.name: _async_run_redis_mget_operation
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous multi-get operation on Redis Cluster.

methods.name: test_connection
methods.description: Tests the Redis Cluster connection by pinging the cluster and returning success or failure status.
